description: A meat shop ships their burger patties using refrigerated trucks and vans. Each truck can take 1000 patties at a cost of $300 per trip. Each van can take 500 patties at a cost of $100 per trip. Because the trucks have difficulty moving around in the city, the number of trucks must not exceed the number of vans. The meat shop has to ship at least 50000 patties and they have a budget of $12500. How should they plan their shipment to minimize the total number of trips?

Capacity.definition: Capacity of each vehicle type in number of patties

CostPerTrip.definition: Cost per trip for each vehicle type

MinPatties.definition: Minimum number of patties to be shipped

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of trips made by trucks and vans to ship the patties"
objective.code: model.setObjective(quicksum(NumTrips[i] for i in range(NumVehicleTypes)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

constraints.description: The total number of patties shipped must be at least 50000
The total shipping cost must not exceed 12500
The number of trucks used must not exceed the number of vans used
The number of trips for each vehicle type must be a non-negative integer

NumTrips.definition: Number of trips made by each vehicle type
